business: Al Hamad Advocates and Legal Consultant
summary: A UAE law firm appears to lose clients to generic consulting copy, a free builder address and a hotmail contact.

findings.problem: The copy appears to be generic consulting text, such as Branding & Positioning Analysis and Grow Your Business, and it names no legal practice areas.
findings.cost: A visitor looking for a lawyer cannot see whether you handle their case, so they call a firm that names it.
findings.fix: Real practice areas written for your clients.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a Wix banner on the page.
findings.cost: A free builder address looks temporary for a law firm.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a firm email.

findings.problem: The contact appears to be a hotmail address and one phone number, with no WhatsApp.
findings.cost: A free email gives less trust, and clients who want a quick message have no easy way to send one.
findings.fix: A firm email and a one tap WhatsApp button.

findings.problem: The page appears to carry a 2019 copyright date, and the menu appears to have only Home and Book Online.
findings.cost: A thin, dated page gives a visitor little reason to trust the firm with a case.
findings.fix: Practice pages, team profiles and an enquiry form.
